job_title: Head of IT Infrastructure & Security (VP / SVP level inferred)
role_summary: Senior IT leadership role responsible for end-to-end management of banking IT infrastructure, data center operations, network, system security, and access management. The incumbent must align IT strategy with regulatory requirements, lead a sizable team, and ensure stable, secure, and compliant IT operations across Hong Kong, Macau, and Mainland China branches.
must_have_requirements: Bachelor degree or above in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline
Minimum 15 years of relevant IT experience, including at least 10 years in a managerial capacity
Hands-on expertise in IT infrastructure, data center operations, network architecture, and system security within the banking or financial services industry
Proven experience managing IT security policies, access management, and compliance with banking regulatory requirements (e.g., HKMA, HKSAR supervisory guidelines)
Demonstrated experience leading and motivating a large IT team across multiple functions
Experience in incident management and service delivery governance aligned to internal policies and regulatory standards
Proficiency in written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin)
nice_to_have_requirements: Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, ITIL, or equivalent
Experience with multi-region or cross-border IT operations (Hong Kong, Macau, Mainland China)
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure or hybrid data center environments in a banking context
Experience with mandatory provident fund, wealth management, or securities IT platforms
Exposure to PBOC or Mainland China banking regulatory IT requirements in addition to HKMA guidelines
Track record of IT infrastructure modernisation or transformation projects in banking
soft_skills_priority: Strong leadership and team motivation — must inspire and develop a sizable multi-disciplinary IT team
Problem-solving under pressure — incident management requires decisive, calm action under tight deadlines
Client-centricity and sense of urgency — internal stakeholders treated as clients, fast incident resolution expected
Risk awareness and security culture building — cultivate team mindset around stable and secure operations
Strategic thinking — ability to develop and execute multi-year IT infrastructure roadmaps
Communication and stakeholder management — bridge technical and non-technical audiences in English and Chinese

scoring_criteria.name: Years of Relevant IT Experience & Seniority
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD explicitly requires 15+ years total IT experience; seniority signals capacity to own a complex, regulated environment
evidence_type_to_look_for: Total years of IT career explicitly stated
Progressive seniority from engineer to manager to director/VP
Scope of roles: team size, budget, geography
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates with under 12 years total experience are likely underqualified

scoring_criteria.name: Managerial Experience in IT Infrastructure / Operations
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: 10 years of managerial experience is a hard threshold; the role leads a sizable multi-function IT team
evidence_type_to_look_for: Direct reports count and team structure described
Titles such as IT Manager, Senior IT Manager, Head of IT, VP IT, IT Director
Evidence of managing cross-functional teams: network, security, operations, helpdesk
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from individual contributor or specialist-only backgrounds will score low

scoring_criteria.name: Banking Industry IT Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Banking has unique regulatory, compliance, and risk requirements; industry-specific knowledge is essential for day-one effectiveness
evidence_type_to_look_for: Named banking or financial services employers
References to HKMA, MAS, or equivalent banking regulatory compliance
Experience with core banking systems, payment infrastructure, or financial system security
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Non-banking IT candidates would face a steep learning curve on regulatory requirements

scoring_criteria.name: IT Security Policy & Regulatory Compliance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Developing and deploying IT security policy in accordance with regulatory requirements is a core deliverable of this role
evidence_type_to_look_for: Authored or reviewed IT security policies
Experience with ISO 27001, NIST, or banking-specific security frameworks
Audit, regulatory inspection, or compliance remediation track record
Security awareness program development

scoring_criteria.name: Data Center Operations & Incident Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Managing data center operations and incident response is a named responsibility; stability of banking services depends on this competency
evidence_type_to_look_for: Data center management experience stated
ITIL or equivalent service management framework usage
Incident commander or major incident management experience
BCP/DR planning and testing

scoring_criteria.name: Network & IT Infrastructure Technical Depth
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role requires sound technical knowledge to make credible decisions on infrastructure acquisition, deployment, and security
evidence_type_to_look_for: Network architecture design or oversight
Server, storage, virtualisation platform management
Infrastructure refresh or transformation projects
Specific vendor or technology mentions relevant to enterprise banking environments

scoring_criteria.name: Identity & Access Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Centralised and secure access management is explicitly called out as a key responsibility
evidence_type_to_look_for: IAM or PAM programme ownership
Active Directory, LDAP, or SSO administration at scale
Access governance or user lifecycle management experience
Role-based access control implementation

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic IT Planning & Vendor Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires developing strategic acquisition and installation schedules for IT infrastructure aligned to bank growth
evidence_type_to_look_for: Multi-year IT roadmap development
IT budget or capex responsibility
Vendor evaluation, RFP, and contract management
Board or EXCO-level IT reporting or presentation

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership, Team Development & Risk Culture
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Cultivating risk awareness and developing team members is explicitly stated; cultural leadership is as important as technical leadership
evidence_type_to_look_for: Staff coaching, mentoring, or succession planning mentioned
Risk awareness training or cultural initiatives led
Examples of team performance improvement or capability uplift
Low attrition or team stability achievements

scoring_criteria.name: Language Proficiency (English & Chinese incl. Mandarin)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Operations span Hong Kong, Macau, and Mainland China; Mandarin is required for Mainland branch coordination and regulatory interaction
evidence_type_to_look_for: Explicit language skills section listing English, Cantonese, Mandarin
Experience working across HK and Mainland China teams
Education or certifications obtained in both English and Chinese mediums
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates without Mandarin may struggle with Mainland China branch responsibilities
